question: Who among the following became the first para-athlete of India to receive the Padma Bhushan in the year 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Devendra Jhajharia**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Devendra Jhajharia** became the first para-athlete of India to receive the Padma Bhushan in the year 2022.
 
• The Padma Bhushan is the third-highest civilian award in India, recognizing distinguished service of a high order in any field.
 
• Devendra Jhajharia is a javelin thrower and has won multiple medals in the Paralympics, including gold medals in 2004 and 2016.
 
• His achievements have been a source of inspiration for many aspiring para-athletes in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pramod Bhagat** is a para-badminton player who has also made significant contributions to Indian sports.
 
• **Harvinder Singh** is known for his achievements in para-archery.
 
• **Manoj Sarkar** is another notable para-badminton player from India.
 
• The **Padma Awards** are one of the highest civilian honors in India and are announced annually on the eve of Republic Day.
